_readme: Baseline input snapshot for XAU_PYRAMID V001 (the compiled defaults). Used by freeze-candidate.mjs as the parameter snapshot; any change is a new version.
_fix_2026_08_20: RelativeATR is now bar-time normalized: rel = (ATR(entryTF)/ATR(longTF)) * sqrt(longTF/entryTF). The original cross-TF ratio sat at ~0.14 and could never enter the [0.6,3.0] band, blocking every entry (BASELINE-0001 = 0 trades in 8y). Parameter VALUES below are unchanged; the fix is in VolatilityFilter.mqh semantics.
